from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=programs/'task-aeeeb77d.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            min_r = min(y for y, x in cells)
            max_r = max(y for y, x in cells)
            min_c = min(x for y, x in cells)
            max_c = max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [(y-min_r, x-min_c, grid[y][x]) for y, x in cells]
            objects.append((min_c, min_r, max_r-min_r+1, max_c-min_c+1, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: (obj[0], obj[1]))

    out = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    anchor_r = anchor_c = 0
    for i, (_, _, height, width, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        for dy, dx, color in shape:
            y, x = anchor_r + dy, anchor_c + dx
            if 0 <= y < rows and 0 <= x < cols:
                out[y][x] = color
        if i + 1 < len(objects):
            anchor_r += height - 1
            anchor_c += width - 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_aeeeb77d', program_path)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
print(program_path)
